Dear Miss Yonge	.
The presentation copies will be attended to. The [book](/book/63) however is hardly yet in the binders hands. Books like 'long-tailed birds of Paradise' will not light at the end.
[I](/person/939) am glad that the Danvers name seems connected with [Mr Peabody](/person/1990). We should send him a copy.
The 62 pages of your law[?] makes 92 of the [Book of Worthies](/book/80)[^1] (I am afraid I [illegible] I like our first title best) so we would like about ms 250 pages, more or less, additional for the volume.
I think your [disciples of St John](/book/72) should be excellent. [Miss Martin](/person/971) will write you in a day or two.
Yours very faithfully
A. Macmillan


[^1]: The sense of this is presumably \'your large law paper\'.
